name: china-real-world-search
description: Verify mainland-China government, public-institution, and state-owned public-service procedures and operations without turning every China-related question into local research.

interface.shortDescription: Verify current China government and state public-service procedures
interface.longDescription: Use only for mainland-China public-facing services provided by government bodies, public institutions, or state-owned/state-controlled public-service operators when current local execution matters. It verifies rules, materials, fees, channels, outlets, schedules, operating status, and public-transport routes while explicitly excluding unrelated consumer technology, products, company research, investment, and private commercial searches.
defaultPrompt: 核实这个中国大陆政务事项现在具体怎么办理，别只复述旧官网。
查询这项国有公共服务的当前渠道、网点、资费或运行状态。
规划依赖铁路、地铁、公交等公共交通的实际路线，并核对当前运营信息。
